n, k = map(int, input().split())

P = 1000000007

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, size=0, val=0):
        self.size = size
        self.data = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
        for i in range(size):
            self.data[i][i] = val

    def multiply(self, other):
        assert self.size == other.size
        result = Matrix(self.size)
        for i in range(self.size):
            for j in range(self.size):
                for k in range(self.size):
                    result.data[i][k] = (result.data[i][k] + self.data[i][j] * other.data[j][k]) % P
        return result

    def multiply_assign(self, other):
        self = self.multiply(other)
        return self

    def power(self, e):
        res = Matrix(self.size, 1)
        base = self
        exp = e
        while exp > 0:
            if exp & 1:
                res = res.multiply(base)
            base = base.multiply(base)
            exp >>= 1
        return res

if n <= k:
    print((1 << n) % P)
    exit()

import math
logN = int(math.log(n + 0.0, k + 0.0)) + 2

shift = Matrix(k + 1, 1)
for j in range(k):
    shift.data[j][j] = 0
    shift.data[(j + 1) % k][j] = 1

block = [Matrix(k + 1, 1) for _ in range(logN)]
block[0] = Matrix(k + 1, 1)
for i in range(1, k + 1):
    block[0].data[0][i] = 1

for i in range(1, logN):
    block[i] = (block[i - 1].multiply(shift)).power(k)

idx = 0
length = 1
while n // length >= k:
    idx += 1
    length *= k

m = Matrix(k + 1, 1)
rem = n
currentLen = length
i = idx

while rem > 0:
    if currentLen <= rem:
        x = rem // currentLen
        m = m.multiply((block[i].multiply(shift)).power(x))
        rem -= currentLen * x
    i -= 1
    currentLen //= k

ans = 0
for i in range(k + 1):
    ans = (ans + m.data[i][k]) % P
print(ans)
